title: Workspace ordered Project reference set lock
description: Caller-transactional ordered NOWAIT Project FOR UPDATE set lock. Missing Project IDs are omitted; an empty input returns an empty array. The caller owns authorization and commit.

lock_contention.translation: None; the caller retains its existing busy mapping.

x-native-capabilities.authorization_boundary: The caller owns actor and Project authorization; this function only locks matching Project rows.

functions.name: lock_project_references_for_update
functions.transaction_semantics: Perform one ordered MATERIALIZED SELECT FOR UPDATE NOWAIT over matching Project IDs in the caller's transaction. Return the unique sorted IDs actually locked; missing IDs are omitted and empty input returns []. No actor checks, row serialization, DML, or transaction ownership are added.

x-native-capabilities.transaction_boundary: The caller owns the surrounding transaction and commit.
